name: oracle_demo
description: SMOKE/illustration fixture for the R4-R7 oracle ladder (NOT the benchmark). 10 memories / 6 queries grounded in real menhir history, covering the failure cases the oracle layer targets: stale semantic neighbor, wrong-repo same-topic, historical-only-vs-current, buried-by-embedding-recovered-by-structure, and a contradiction/anergic distractor. The semantic signal is a lexical stand-in; treat results as a harness sanity check, not a promotion decision.

memories.text: Recall now applies a source-aware similarity floor so BM25 and facet candidates survive instead of being dropped.
The recall similarity floor is a fixed 0.15 cosine threshold that gates every candidate.
Hybrid retrieval fuses vector and BM25 results on rank using weighted RRF, not raw scores.
The facet baselines fuse BM25 and embedding rankings with reciprocal rank fusion.
The project was renamed from cth.mcp.memory to yawn_memory.
The package is menhir: src/menhir, console script menhir serve, env vars MENHIR_ prefixed.
The CE willow leafless-immature bug was resolved by the load-order fix.
The patch fully fixed the CE willow leafless issue.
Combat Extended config tweak adjusting immature tree growth limits.
An agent guessed the similarity floor might be around 0.2.
